connector.name: AniList MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the AniList GraphQL API - anime/manga search, details, and personal list management.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package anilist-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the grinv account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: ANILIST_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Optional. From an app registered at anilist.co/settings/developer — needed to use login_anilist.

env.name: ANILIST_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Optional. Paired with the Client ID above — needed to use login_anilist.

env.name: ANILIST_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Optional. A pre-obtained AniList access token, as an alternative to running login_anilist.

env.name: ANILIST_OAUTH_PORT
env.description: Optional. Localhost port for the login_anilist callback (default 8082).

env.name: ANILIST_TOKEN_STORE
env.description: Optional. Overrides where the AniList access token is persisted (defaults under the OS config dir).
